proposition: Demerzel cross-references between governance artifacts resolve correctly (behavioral tests, estimator pairings, policy references, and schema $refs)

supporting.claim: All 17 personas have a corresponding behavioral case file in tests/behavioral/, e.g., demerzel-cases.md, skeptical-auditor-cases.md, seldon-cases.md. Tests are substantive and contain assertions.
Every persona with estimator_pairing references the existing skeptical-auditor persona (personas/skeptical-auditor.persona.yaml). No broken estimator pairings found.
Sampled policy and constitution references in personas, constitutions, and skills resolve to existing files in policies/ and constitutions/. No dangling references detected in the sample.

logic/governance-evolution.schema.json $ref now points to /schemas/tetravalent-state and resolves. All other logic schemas use the same /schemas/ tetravalent reference. Contract schemas use relative integrity-fields.schema.json refs that resolve within schemas/contracts/.

Re-evaluated 2026-09-12. The naming-convention dissent is resolved, but the stale-artifact dissent is verified still standing (64 state files beyond the 7-day threshold, the named ones at 173-178d). Holding an affirmative verdict against standing verified dissent is the false confidence substrate_audit exists to catch, so the verdict moves to C (Contradictory) — matching what hari's substrate already resolves — until the stale artifacts have a producer. [CORRECTED 2026-09-12: the stale-artifact dissent this entry calls standing was mismeasured — see resolved_contradictions. The move to C was wrong and is reverted.]

With the mismeasured staleness dissent retired, no standing evidence contests that cross-references resolve. The verdict returns to its pre-dissent P@0.8 rather than T: the policy-reference evidence is still a sample, and retiring a bad objection is not new support.

resolved_contradictions.claim: Behavioral case files use the naming convention {persona}-cases.md, but policies/governance-audit-policy.yaml specifies the expected filenames as {persona}.test.md or {persona}.test.yaml. This is a convention drift between policy and repository practice.
resolved_contradictions.resolution: Superseded. The convention drift is gone: policies/governance-audit-policy.yaml now states the 'established tests/behavioral/*-cases.md convention' and checks for tests/behavioral/{name}-cases.md, which is what the repository uses.
resolved_contradictions.resolution_verified_by: read policies/governance-audit-policy.yaml on 2026-09-12 (convention stated at line 8, check at line 112) against the actual tests/behavioral/*-cases.md filenames

resolved_contradictions.claim: STILL STANDING, re-measured 2026-09-12 and worse than when first recorded: 64 files under state/ carry a last_updated older than the 7-day threshold. Every file this item named in July remains stale — state/beliefs/2026-03-17-behavioral-test-coverage.belief.json and 2026-03-18-consumer-repo-integration-status.belief.json at 173d, the three 2026-03-17 state/evolution/*.evolution.json records at 178d. These artifacts have no producer refreshing them, so cross-references resolve to records that no longer describe the repository.
resolved_contradictions.resolution: Mismeasured, retired. The count applied the 7-day ACTIVE-artifact threshold to every file under state/, but policies/governance-audit-policy.yaml check audit-2-6 (1.1.0, reconciled 2026-07-28) holds historical state records — evolution logs, PDCA cycles, audit snapshots, archived records — to a 90-day threshold, reports exceedances as informational rather than failures, and says not to flag them merely for being referenced. Classified by lifecycle, the stale set is mostly terminal records: conscience signals carrying a RESOLVED outcome, a regret with status resolved, council and trigger event records, dated evolution snapshots. Separately, age does not contest this proposition at all: it asserts that references RESOLVE, and an old record still resolves. The one active artifact in the set, 2026-03-18-consumer-repo-integration-status, was re-evaluated on its own merits.
resolved_contradictions.resolution_verified_by: read policies/governance-audit-policy.yaml audit-2-6 on 2026-09-12; enumerated tracked state/**/*.json older than 7 days outside archived/ with their lifecycle fields (status, outcome, cycle_phase, assessment.recommendation)
